CONTROL.name: Healthy Control
CONTROL.description: No known pathology. MRI is expected to show normal anatomy and signal characteristics for age.
keyFeatures: No focal lesions or mass effect.
Normal ventricular size and sulcal pattern.

SCHZ.name: Schizophrenia
SCHZ.description: Neuroimaging may be normal or show subtle structural changes. Findings are supportive, not diagnostic.
keyFeatures: Subtle cortical or hippocampal volume changes.
No focal mass or acute lesion.

BIPOLAR.name: Bipolar Disorder
BIPOLAR.description: Structural MRI is often normal; changes are subtle and non-specific. Imaging is mainly used to exclude other causes.
keyFeatures: Possible subtle volume changes in limbic regions.

ADHD.name: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder
ADHD.description: Structural MRI is typically clinicaly unremarkable. Research-level morphometry may show subtle volume reductions in circuits involving the basal ganglia and prefrontal cortex.
keyFeatures: No gross structural abnormalities or focal lesions.
Possible subtle reduction in total gray matter volume.
Potential volume differences in the caudate nucleus or cerebellum (research context only).

GBM.name: Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)
GBM.description: Aggressive primary brain tumor with necrosis and infiltrative growth.
keyFeatures: Mass effect and possible midline shift.

MENINGIOMA.name: Meningioma
MENINGIOMA.description: Extra-axial tumor arising from meninges, typically well-circumscribed with uniform enhancement.
keyFeatures: Extra-axial mass with broad dural attachment.

MS.name: Multiple Sclerosis
MS.description: Autoimmune demyelinating disease with characteristic white matter lesions.
